'''Fotbollsföreningen Jaro''' (''Jakobstads Rostfria''), commonly known simply as '''Jaro''', is a [[Finland|Finnish]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in the [[bilingual]] town of [[Jakobstad]]. The club currently plays in [[Veikkausliiga]], the top tier in Finland."}}
